cards.title: The item-13 difficulty currency disagrees with itself
cards.detail: pet-island-difficulty.md §5 and slice-1 §4 are in the same currency and disagree. Today one sum banks one unit against a tile costing 1–16. §5 sets easy=2, tricky=3, honeymoon=4; Phase 3 adds mastered=1. Either the cost curve re-bases or session length halves. Run A7 re-bases units ×2 invisibly; this card is the REMAINING question about differential pay.

cards.title: Does v1 ship without adaptive difficulty?
cards.detail: Fable's view: yes, since today's fixed difficulty is the v0 behaviour she already plays. Joe's call.

cards.title: The two overlays behave differently
cards.detail: Tapping outside a tile offer returns to the island (zero-cost menu). Tapping outside a CHALLENGE does nothing (work in progress). Recorded as a rule in HANDOFF §6, but it is a feel judgement and Juno is the only real judge.

cards.title: A camera gesture is live that was never ruled on
cards.detail: Tapping her own land turns the island about that tile. Costless, cannot start a round, but it is a product change to a gesture Joe had explicitly ruled on. Veto is one line in interactions.ts (the focusOn call in the tile case).

cards.title: Lighting review, tilt-shift, more fog, visual options menu (#43)
cards.detail: END OF PHASE 4. What is missing is measured fps on the actual mid-range Android tablet — nothing in this project has ever been measured there. Order: measure → amend the brief → build. ?flat already exists reserved for this. The DEFAULTS matter more than the options, because she will never open a settings menu.

cards.title: Get it in front of Juno again (#34)
cards.detail: The highest-value action that is not code. Everything she reported on 27 July is fixed. It is also the only way to judge what was decided on a DPR-1 desktop at night by one person: the font, the prop shadows, the tap target, the 3:1 ratio, the camera gesture.

cards.title: One found word banks the whole page (#44)
cards.detail: earned is set by flyToScore, which the word-find fires on EVERY found word, not on completion. Run A1 fixes the scoring semantics; this card closes when A1 lands with its regression test.

cards.title: void async over a loop — three more sites (#46)
cards.detail: props.ts water-piece and cloud load, pets.ts sync(), album.ts portraits.shoot. One rejection abandons every item after it AND surfaces unhandled. Also: the scatter comment claims a lost cover piece is re-dressed next sync — FALSE, placed.add(k) runs before scatter().

cards.title: A quarter of dead trunks flicker shadowless (#47)
cards.detail: VARY has no real floor — (dh >> 13) % span is a signed shift on an unsigned hash, so 48.8% of pieces get a negative term. Do NOT fix by flipping the shift: that re-rolls the size of half the scenery on every island that already exists. Fix by shadowing by KIND, or correct the test.

cards.title: Batch the blob shadows before the 40-tile island (#47b)
cards.detail: createBlobShadow makes fresh geometry AND material per blob; +1 draw call each, ~70 extra at 40 tiles. Must exclude pets, whose castShadow mutates opacity per frame. Natural home: beside the Phase 5 lighting rework.

cards.title: Album pop-out (#31)
cards.detail: Tap a pet for a larger card: rotating pet, NAME, SPECIES, find-it-on-the-map, speak-its-name. Five things already established — see docs/BACKLOG.md. Notably: no display name exists for a species, and a rotating pop-out means a live loop on a second WebGL context.

cards.title: Pure play elements as a session reward (#39)
cards.detail: PARKED — not to be built without Joe. The observation matters as much as the idea: after an hour of earning, the reward she chose for herself was unstructured looking. The cheapest "pure play element" may be to stop obstructing the play she has already invented.

cards.title: Prop glTFs 404 on a texture that is never used (#45)
cards.detail: props/*.gltf reference hexagons_medieval.png but the folder ships only the _Summer variant. Harmless, but it has cost two agents time. A clean console is a debugging tool. Cheapest fix is the loading manager.

cards.title: Tablet screenshot wanted: a rim mountain's shadow
cards.detail: Hills and mountains throw an ellipse landing ~3.7 units from the base, spanning neighbours and overhanging the sea. Arithmetic is right for a 35° sun. If it reads broken on the tablet, cap stretch/radius for big features rather than inventing clipping.

cards.title: The asset viewer galleries
cards.detail: BUILT 28 Jul. Three galleries at /viewer.html — species (24, turntable, dressed in any of the 40 sets), tiles (6 render kinds incl. every coast variant, switchable across all four seasonal atlases), props (130 entries across both packs). Every ID comes from the game's own registries and every model through the game's own loader. Reports both directions: registry names with no file, and files no table names (30 forest pieces, on purpose). Notes POST straight to joe/asset-notes.json keyed by canonical ID.

cards.title: Fred-talk has no way in
cards.detail: Joe, ruling JT-008(2): 'we have no fred talk set up, open a card for that.' He is right, and the machinery is not the missing part — build.ts still has fredTalk(), FRED_SOUNDS and a fred() handle, and A2 now reports it through onHelp('fred'). What is missing is any affordance that reaches it: the overlay wires 'say it again' and nothing else, and the mash rescue was deliberately changed to say the whole word slowly instead (build.ts header, product owner's call: TTS stop consonants bark). So the code path is live and unreachable. Two halves to decide together: (a) the WAY IN, which Run C already specs as the second step of the hint ladder ('Fred, show me?'), so building a button now may be building it twice; (b) the VOICE, which is JT-006 - the 43 recorded phonemes are what make sounding-out pleasant rather than merely available. Sequencing note: A2's help reporting is already wired, so whenever this lands it is measured on arrival with no further work.
